title: Marriage and children while on the road
summary: His wife stayed home having babies; they married in Chicago, and all their children were born in New York.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Did your wife travel with you at times?
No. No. She was too busy having babies.
We got married right after I came to New York.
We got married in Chicago, though, but we were going together in New York.
Oh, that's great, yeah. And is that when your first girl was -- your second girl.
No, my first girl. All my kids were born in New York.
Yeah, sure. Every one of them.
